# Troubleshooting

Start with `greenfield doctor`. It runs every check below, prints `[ ok ]`, `[warn]`, `[FAIL]` or `[info]` for each, and gives the command that fixes each problem. It changes nothing unless you pass `--fix`, which only repairs folder permissions and `.gitignore` lines, and it opens no network connections unless you pass `--network`.

```bash
greenfield doctor
greenfield doctor --fix
```

It exits 0 when nothing failed, 1 when a check failed, and 3 on an unsupported platform. `greenfield --json doctor` prints the same results as JSON.

## Environment

### `environment.python`

The Python running Greenfield. It needs 3.11 or newer.

Can report: pass, fail.

Fix:

- Install Python 3.11 or newer

### `environment.platform`

Whether this system has POSIX file locking. Native Windows does not, so the commands that lock files refuse there; use WSL.

Can report: fail, pass.

Fix:

- Use WSL (https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/wsl/install); score, ledger verify, portfolio and doctor work here

### `environment.which`

Whether the `greenfield` on your PATH is the same version as the copy you are running. A mismatch means an old pipx or uvx install is shadowing this one.

Can report: warn, info, pass.

Fix:

- `pipx upgrade greenfield-evaluator` (or: greenfield install --force)

## Install

### `install.present`

Whether the skill is installed for Claude Code or Codex, at project or user scope.

Can report: pass, fail.

Fix:

- `greenfield install --platform both`

### `install.intact`

Whether the installed skill files still match the install manifest. A difference means someone edited the installed copy or an install was interrupted.

Can report: fail, warn, pass.

Fix:

- `greenfield install --force`

### `install.shadowing`

Whether the skill is installed at both project and user scope with different versions. The host uses the project copy.

Can report: warn, pass.

Fix:

- `greenfield uninstall --scope user` (or --scope project) to remove the one you do not want

### `install.agents`

Whether all nine research role files are present and match this package.

Can report: fail, warn, pass.

Fix:

- `greenfield install --force`

## Hooks

### `hooks.configured`

Whether the optional Mission Control hooks are installed in this project.

Can report: pass, info.

Fix:

- `greenfield hooks install`

### `hooks.script_path`

Whether every Greenfield hook points at a script that exists. A missing script makes the host print an error on every tool call.

Can report: fail, pass.

Fix:

- `greenfield hooks install`

### `hooks.guard`

Whether the PreToolUse guard that stops agents from recording human attestations is installed.

Can report: pass, warn.

Fix:

- `greenfield hooks install`
- `greenfield hooks install --guard-only`

### `hooks.stale_posttooluse`

Whether an older install left a PostToolUse hook behind. It costs a Python start on every tool call and nothing reads it.

Can report: warn, pass.

Fix:

- `greenfield hooks install` (removes the leftover entry)

### `hooks.codex_trust`

Codex keeps hook trust outside the project, so doctor cannot see it. Approve the hooks in Codex yourself.

Can report: info.

Fix:

- Open /hooks in Codex and approve the Greenfield hooks

## Privacy

### `privacy.permissions`

Whether `.greenfield-observe/` is readable only by you (folders 0700, files 0600).

Can report: fail, pass.

Fix:

- `greenfield doctor --fix`

### `privacy.ignored`

Whether `.greenfield-observe/` and `research/greenfield/` are kept out of git.

Can report: fail, pass.

Fix:

- `git rm -r --cached .greenfield-observe research/greenfield` (not run for you)
- `greenfield doctor --fix`

## Attestation

### `attestation.legacy_receipts`

Whether ledger receipts store absolute paths, which break when the research folder moves.

Can report: warn, pass.

Fix:

- Re-record those receipts with `greenfield evidence add`; they still resolve, with a warning, for one release

### `attestation.hmac_key`

Whether the local key that signs human attestations exists and is private.

Can report: warn, fail, pass.

Fix:

- It is created on your first `greenfield evidence add`
- `chmod 600 <...>`

## Run

### `run.readiness`

Whether the active run's `evaluation.json` validates, so `greenfield score` can score it.

Can report: info, warn, pass.

Fix:

- Write it from the evaluation template, then `greenfield score`
- Fix it, then run `greenfield score <...>`

### `run.ledger`

Whether the active run's experiment ledger hash chain is intact.

Can report: info, pass, fail.

Fix:

- Restore <...> from a backup or git; the first broken event is named above

### `run.inbox_pii`

Whether files in `materials/inbox/`, which the assistant may read, hold personal data.

Can report: warn.

Fix:

- Run the greenfield evidence redact command it names

### `run.active`

Whether there is an active research run and its folder exists.

Can report: info, pass, fail.

Fix:

- `greenfield start --idea '...'`
- `greenfield start --new`

## Dashboard

### `dashboard.port`

Whether the default dashboard port 8765 is free. Checked only with `--network`.

Can report: warn, pass, info.

Fix:

- `greenfield dashboard --port 8766`
- `greenfield doctor --network`

## Network

### `network.reachability`

Whether this machine can open an HTTPS connection. Checked only with `--network`.

Can report: info, pass, warn.

Fix:

- `greenfield doctor --network`
- Set your proxy (HTTPS_PROXY) or work offline; offline commands are unaffected

## Agent

### `agent.web_access`

Doctor cannot see whether your agent host has web browsing. Research without it ends as Research incomplete.

Can report: info.

Fix:

- Enable browsing in your agent host before research

## Still stuck

Run `greenfield --json doctor` and open an issue at <https://github.com/aarongbaker/greenfield-business-evaluator/issues> with the output. Remove anything private first.
